_comment: MCP servers Alil can reach via the on-demand mcp.* meta-tools. Tools are NEVER injected into context; the model discovers them with mcp.search → mcp.inspect → mcp.call. Empty `servers` (the default) means MCP is off. Each entry: { name, transport: 'stdio', command, args?, env?, timeoutMs?, minEffect? }. Example (disabled): a filesystem server.
